basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old from Toronto, Canada, currently working as a software developer. I love diving into the world of Genshin Impact during my evenings and weekends. My interests include gaming, indie music, and exploring creative communities online. I'm in a long-term relationship, and my partner and I enjoy attending local music gigs. My typical online hours are late evenings during weekdays and sporadically over the weekends. I dislike toxic online environments and try to contribute positively wherever I can.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for the past five years. My expertise lies in software development with a focus on web applications. In my spare time, I enjoy learning new programming languages and staying updated with the latest tech trends.
